CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.current_staff_id()
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select s.staff_id
  from public.staff s
  where s.auth_user_id = (select auth.uid())
    and s.status = 'Aktif'
  limit 1
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.protect_report_identity()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
  if new.staff_id is distinct from old.staff_id
     or new.nama_snapshot is distinct from old.nama_snapshot
     or new.bidang_snapshot is distinct from old.bidang_snapshot
     or new.role_snapshot is distinct from old.role_snapshot
     or new.created_by_username is distinct from old.created_by_username
     or new.created_by_staff_id is distinct from old.created_by_staff_id
     or new.created_by_name is distinct from old.created_by_name
     or new.created_by_role is distinct from old.created_by_role
  then
    raise exception 'Identitas pemilik laporan tidak dapat diubah';
  end if;
  return new;
end;
$function$
